answer: The hollow holds work receipts rather than names, so the ferrous of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
